question: What claim about totality is at stake in positing a single field-group for all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: A single all-field group is posited for them.
inference: The totality of earth-moving and sky-moving yoginīs is assigned to one comprehensive field-group.
uncertainties: The structure of that field-group is not specified here.
plain_english: The all-field group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
